quests.title: Update Your LinkedIn Profile
quests.description: Add your latest projects, skills, and a professional headline that reflects your career goals.

quests.title: Tailor Your Resume for a Job
quests.description: Customize your resume for a specific job posting by incorporating keywords from the job description.

quests.title: Send Your First Cold Outreach
quests.description: Reach out to a recruiter or professional at a company you're interested in. Use one of our templates to get started.

quests.title: Research 5 Target Companies
quests.description: Identify 5 companies you'd like to work for and add them to your company list with notes about why they interest you.

quests.title: Practice a Technical Interview Question
quests.description: Solve one coding challenge or technical problem relevant to your field. Document your approach.

quests.title: Follow Up on an Application
quests.description: Send a follow-up email for an application you submitted 7-10 days ago.

quests.title: Connect with 3 People on LinkedIn
quests.description: Send personalized connection requests to 3 professionals in your target industry.

quests.title: Optimize Your Resume for ATS
quests.description: Use our CV matcher tool to analyze your resume and improve your ATS score to at least 70.

quests.title: Write a Cover Letter
quests.description: Draft a compelling cover letter for one of your target positions.

quests.title: Set Your Weekly Goals
quests.description: Define realistic weekly goals for applications and outreach activities.

quests.title: Request an Informational Interview
quests.description: Ask someone in your network for a brief informational interview or coffee chat.

quests.title: Build Your Elevator Pitch
quests.description: Write and practice a 30-second elevator pitch about who you are and what you're looking for.

quests.title: Track Your Applications
quests.description: Log all your active applications in JobBuddy and add relevant notes and dates.

quests.title: Prepare STAR Stories
quests.description: Write 3 STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) stories for behavioral interviews.

quests.title: Join a Professional Community
quests.description: Join an online community, Slack group, or Discord server related to your industry.
